entries.title: II Chronicles 35:2
segments: Rulers should ever encourage good works; and labor to unite all calsses, especially ministers of religion, in the regular and habitual worship of God.

entries.title: II Chronicles 35:3
segments: Put the holy ark in the house; it is commonly supposed that some time before the reign of Josiah, the ark had been removed from the most holy place--perhaps because it was out of repair--and committed to the custody of the Kohathites, as before the temple was built.

entries.title: II Chronicles 35:6
segments: Due preparation is necessary to acceptable worship.

entries.title: II Chronicles 35:10
segments: When those in authority set the example, and ministers of religion faithfully do their duty, many may be expected to engage in the service of God.

entries.title: II Chronicles 35:20
segments:
Prepared the temple; for the observance of divine worship, according to the law of Moses and the commandments of David and Solomon. 
 
  Charchemish; a strongly fortified city on the river Euphrates.

entries.title: II Chronicles 35:22
segments:
Valley of Megiddo; near th river Kishon, in the tribe of Manasseh; it formed a part of the great plain of Esdraelon. 
 
It is hazardous to engage in any enterprise, without first asking counsel of God and obtaining his approbation.

entries.title: II Chronicles 35:25
segments: Many lament the removal of great and good men, who have not given heed to their instructions while they were living, nor imitated their example after they were dead.
